text:
Alex: Heads-up: PR #61288 updates runtime batch allocator and surfaces a small gRPC header ordering change on the platform side. Need runtime + platform + security eyes before merge. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/61288

Maria: Looking now. Is this backward-compatible or do clients need to change?

Alex: Should be backward-compatible. The only behavioural change is how we emit duplicate headers — we introduced a flag `preserve_header_order` (default true). Quick snippet in the PR: `grpc_conn->set_header_order_preserve(true);`

Sam: From runtime: I can take the allocator changes. Will run perf benches. One quick question — does the allocator default change for small sequences?

Alex: Yes, we change small-seq eviction from LRU->size-based to reduce allocations in micro-batches. I added unit tests but perf suite will show tail-latency impact.

Jordan: I'll look at the gRPC surface and where the header makes it into our platform proxy. We should loop in security for header semantics. @Maya-sec pinged.

Maya-sec: Adding security. Quick Q: are you modifying auth token parsing or just transport headers? If auth parsing changes, we need a deeper review.

Alex: Only transport headers — no auth parsing touched. I'll add a short threat-model note + test plan to the PR in the next 30m.

deploy-bot: CI: started checks for PR #61288 — unit tests, integration grpc tests, bench runner queued.

Sam: :eyes: Perf bench queued. Note: recommend a 48h canary for tail-latency because allocator defaults changed.

Jordan: Agree. We should schedule a canary in staging and a small percentage in production if staging looks OK. Who can steward the canary? Prefer Mon morning PST. @Lina can you take this?

Lina: I can steward the canary Mon 09:00 PST. Plan: tag canary as `canary/61288`, target 10% of runtime-dedicated pool, monitor tail latency and error rate. I'll own rollback if needed.

Alex: Thanks Lina. Maria, can you add migration/docs notes about header compatibility? Maya-sec, once you finish your quick pass, pls leave sign-off or required remediation.

Maria: Will add an "Upgrade notes" section and a header compatibility test matrix by EOD.

Maya-sec: Quick pass done — no auth parsing changes. Leaving a short note in the PR and :+1: pending docs and canary results.

Sam: I'll wire up a monitoring dashboard (tagging it `monitoring:pr-61288`) and watch tail-p99.

Alex: Perfect. Requesting final LGTM from runtime & platform once CI + Canary look good. If someone can give an early LGTM to move CI forward, that helps. :pray:

Jordan: I'll try to do a platform pass today and flag anything blocking.

Lina: Canary scheduled and noted. Reach out if you want me to delay to accommodate additional reviewers.

Alex: Appreciate it — will post updates in this thread.
